summary: Max Verstappen won the United States Grand Prix Sprint from pole position, 0.4s ahead of George Russell, with Carlos Sainz completing the podium.
Yuki Tsunoda made the biggest climb, from P18 to P7.
Nico Hulkenberg had a day to forget, dropping from P4 to P13.
The race was neutralised by 2 safety cars.
The stewards penalised BEA (10 second time penalty).
There were 3 pit stops in total; the winner stopped 0 times.
Oscar Piastri leads the championship by 22 points over Lando Norris.
